description: Software Factory inspector: audits each job when it ends (close, cancel or abandon — from Claude, a chat reply or your terminal), reports on session start, applies your finding replies, and keeps its own controls human-only.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.js" || { c=$?; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[factory-inspector:session] node is not on PATH; factory-inspector hooks are off" >&2; exit 1; }; V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null); case "$V" in v[0-9].*|v1[0-3].*) echo "[factory-inspector:session] node $V is too old for the factory-inspector hooks (they need Node 14 or newer): factory-inspector hooks are off" >&2;; *) echo "[factory-inspector:session] hook failed (exit $c)" >&2;; esac; exit 1; }
